# 5 - Face of text
Bold  use double estric **Muhammad Usman** \
Italic use single estric  *Muhammad Usman* \
Bolid and Italica use tripple esteric ***Muhammad Usman***  
You can also you Plus sign (+), underscore (_) instead of esteric \
__Muhammad Usman__ Bold \
_Muhammad Usman_ Italic \
___Muhammad Usman___ Bold and italic
